text:
maya (prod): quick check — Private deployment GA: can we lock SLA targets & support handoff? we need concrete answers for SLA % uptime, latency p50/p95 targets, docs checklist, and pricing tiers. who owns gaps?

sam (eng): for Dedicated/Private we can commit to 99.9% uptime for single-region clusters with redundancy. p95 target depends on model class — e.g. small-gen p95 < 120ms, large-gen p95 < 400ms. need capacity commit and autoscale policy.

eli (sre): agree. need per-route error budget, global latency SLOs + per-customer exemptions. must have tracing + span tags for model_id + shard. runbook: failover to hosted model variant, incident playbook link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/private-ga

chris (finops): pricing: propose three tiers: dev (burst), reserved (monthly commit), enterprise (custom). reserved reduces per-token by 30%. need to align SLA credits on reserved tiers.

maya (prod): docs: add checklist items: KMS/HSM setup, audit log enablement, network diagram, on-prem install steps, compatibility matrix (gpu types, quant configs).

sam (eng): notes: KV cache warmup time might cause early latency blips on cold starts — suggest controlled ramp and prefilling for GA. also quantized models vary CPU/GPU memory footprints, update the compatibility matrix.

eli (sre): monitoring: ingest per-tenant tail-latency histograms, evictions, kernel OOMs, GPU temp. set alerts: p95>target for 5m OR error rate > 1% for 2m. ops escalation: oncall -> infra-sre -> eng-runtime.

chris (finops): need legal signoff on SLA credits. pricing playbook to include sample calculator: monthly_committed_gpus => discount tiers. I'll draft.

maya (prod): action owners: sam = infra perf + kernel notes, eli = runbook + alerts, chris = pricing + credits, docs = me (I'll own checklist). timeline: finalize by EOD Friday for stakeholder review. any blockers?

sam (eng): blocker: we need final perf numbers from model onboarding team for the 3 reference models. pinging @zara for numbers.

deploy-bot: build #9876 finished: private-deploy-run (staging) — all smoke tests passed :white_check_mark:

zara (ml): dropped perf numbers in the drive: gen-small p95=85ms, gen-large p95=420ms (with kv warmed). shared link: https://go/redwood/ml/perf-refs

maya (prod): perfect — thanks. I'll consolidate and send to execs tomorrow.
